name: Soundtrack Finder
description: Recognizes the songs in your movies and TV episodes with Shazam, lists them in each title's description, lets you fix them on a timeline editor, and saves them as tagged MP3s to a Jellyfin music library. Includes a 'Now playing' pop-up, search and statistics. User interface in English, German, French, Spanish and Italian.
overview: Find, edit and save the songs in your movies and series

versions.changelog: Preview images from the movie above the timeline (can be turned off); 'Search on Spotify' and 'Search on YouTube' links.

Interface in English, German, French, Spanish and Italian (automatic or chosen on the page); 'Re-analyze all'; remove saved songs from Jellyfin (per song and per title); 'Scene as MP3' gets proper tags and cover instead of the movie file's title.

'Now playing' pop-ups reach every open Jellyfin Web tab/window of a browser (Jellyfin only sent them to the last active one); timing based on the player's own reports only; clearer diagnostics after a server restart.
'Now playing' shows 🎵 in the text, exact timing, live diagnostics per device, test pop-up, log entries.
'Now playing' pop-up while watching; search across all titles and statistics.
Link '▶ listen & edit' next to the song list in every description; public URL setting; deep links.
Exclusion list for false matches (sound-effect libraries, cover factories); admin button to always exclude an artist.
First version: Shazam recognition, song list in the description, dashboard page with corrections.
